title: docs-drift: bounded history sweep over the 91 enumeration-carrying pages — measure the real rate of uncaught vocabulary widenings (#11817 ruling)
body:
Chartered in #11817's ruling (maintainer, 2026-08-25, verbatim 「其他接受」 accepting the bounded-middle recommendation; full record = #11817 comment 5404972937). Filed by PM session `session_01KWRU3s15AJz7PGW7a7wdCh` per the confirmed checklist.

**Content**: sweep the history of the 91 enumeration-carrying doc pages (#11817 measured 447 enumeration cells / 1363 distinct enumerated spans) for past instances of the class: *an enumerable vocabulary widened in code while the page enumerating it was not updated, and docs-drift stayed green*. Bound the sweep (page set is fixed; pick a defensible history window and state it). Report **identities, not counts** — each instance names the commit/PR, the page, and the missing members.

**Instrument discipline**: positive control first — the method must find the one known instance (#11347's formula-function widening, reproduced byte-for-byte on #11817) before any zero elsewhere is believed.

**Decision rule (pre-ruled on #11817 — ⛔ not re-litigable here)**:
- **≥2 real instances** (the known #11347 one counts as the first) → file a NEW decision card carrying the measured rate; option C (the authored-enumeration regime on the 91 pages) is decided there, on data.
- **0–1 instances** → B (the verdict narrowing, separately dispatched behind PR #11798) is the end state; C is not built; close this card with the measurement as the record.

**Acceptance criterion**: a posted sweep record with the window, the method, the positive-control result, and every instance identified — or a defended zero.
